comment: Documents both storydoc libraries must read AND write identically. Each case is run by tests/server/test_storydoc.py and tests/extension/storydoc/storydoc.test.ts: `text` must parse to `cells`, and re-serialising must produce `dumped` byte for byte. Add a case here and both languages are held to it.

cases.name: an empty document has no cells
a document of only blank lines has no cells
a marker opens a cell and the text below it is the source
cases.text:
<!-- cell: chapter id="c1" title="The First Night" -->

The lantern had gone out.
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: chapter id="c1" title="The First Night" -->

The lantern had gone out.

cases.name: a marker is read whatever spacing it was written with
a document opening with a marker has no empty leading cell
cases.text:
<!-- cell: contents id="c1" -->

<!-- cell: chapter id="c2" title="One" -->

Prose.
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: contents id="c1" -->

<!-- cell: chapter id="c2" title="One" -->

Prose.

cases.name: a cell with no body is kept, because its kind is the point
an unknown kind is carried through untouched
cases.text:
<!-- cell: epigraph id="c1" attribution="Anon" -->

A line of verse.
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: epigraph id="c1" attribution="Anon" -->

A line of verse.

cases.name: several attributes are read in order
cases.text:
<!-- cell: cover id="c1" src="art/cover.jpg" alt="The cover" -->

![The cover](art/cover.jpg)
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: cover id="c1" src="art/cover.jpg" alt="The cover" -->

![The cover](art/cover.jpg)

cases.name: a quote inside an attribute survives escaping
cases.text:
<!-- cell: chapter id="c1" title="She said \"no\"" -->

Prose.
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: chapter id="c1" title="She said \"no\"" -->

Prose.

cases.name: a backslash inside an attribute survives escaping
blank lines inside a cell are the author's and are kept
cases.text:

Second.
cases.dumped:
<!-- cell: chapter id="c1" title="One" -->

First.


Second.
